name: EPIC 248628656
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 14, 6.8 solar radii and 1.01 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 248628656 (K2 campaign 14): PARAM radius (solar radii) 6.788666 (16th-84th percentiles 6.537748-7.048112), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 248628656 (K2 campaign 14): PARAM mass (solar masses) 1.011229 (16th-84th percentiles 0.921671-1.10805), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 248628656: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 5134.475 +/- 71 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 248628656 (K2 campaign 14): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 3171.992188 (16th-84th percentiles 3081.015625-3264.257812), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.06 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the colour routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 3,172 parsecs away, 7 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 14, give 1.01 solar masses and 6.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,134 K at its surface.
